description:
Cast Rite of Flame by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for another instant or sorcery with mana cost equal to {R} and putting it into your hand.
Resolve Rite of Flame, adding {R}{R}.
Cast the other instant or sorcery by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rite of Flame from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the other instant or sorcery spell.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
